item.title: Fortune and Cursed treasure hours schedule in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite is continuing the tradition of special Saturday hourly events during the Chapter 7 mini season , though this time they're treasure hours , centered around the pirate-themed "Treasure Hunters" season. During these hours, certain sprites will get increased drop rates, and you'll drop into the game with special items.

item.title: GTA 6's Autosave Is Ruining The Game, But Not For The Reason You Think
item.description: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 might be the best-rated game of all time , but that doesn't mean players love every single thing about the open-world shooter. Some drawbacks, like the game's wonky controls, can be adjusted. Others, players are simply stuck with. One of the biggest complaints is that GTA 6 's autosave feature simply isn't good enough.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Have Already Discovered an Infinite Money Glitch
item.description: Many players have a habit of optimizing the fun out of video games, and that tendency has unsurprisingly found its way into Grand Theft Auto 6 . Apparently, the game has many ways to “get rich quick,” and these exploitive strategies are going viral online.

item.title: The One Thing About GTA 6's Ending to Know Before You Get Too Far In
item.description: While playing through Grand Theft Auto 6 , you might notice that there are a lot of systems that can alter your experience. There’s the relationship system, your criminal profile, fitness routines that change your physique, and plenty more that gives you a lot of control over Jason and Lucia. In the moment-to-moment gameplay, it can be a little hard to figure out how much of that actually has an impact on the game.

item.title: Yellowjackets Season 4 Episode 1 Ending Explained: What Did Natalie See?
item.description: One of the greatest things about showrunners Ashley Lyle and Bart Nickerson’s psychological horror show Yellowjackets is that you never know what bananas shenanigans will happen next. We’re only one episode into Yellowjackets season 4, and we’re happy to report that this still holds true, with a cliffhanger ending that will leave you wondering what the hell just happened.

item.title: Undertale Creator Officially Teases the End of Deltarune
item.description: It's been almost a decade since Toby Fox released the first chapter of Deltarune , the celebrated indie developer's follow-up to Undertale . Now the end of the story is in sight. In a recent newsletter update, Fox revealed that his team is making good progress on the game's final two chapters.

item.title: GTA 6’s Official Connection to Red Dead Redemption Revealed
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 may have just come out, but players have already discovered many of Leonida's most bizarre secrets, including the return of a certain legendary cryptid . One of these Easter eggs contains a big reveal: Red Dead Redemption and Grand Theft Auto are set in the same universe.

item.title: 6 Steam Games To Wishlist That Aren't GTA 6
item.description: This week, players are finally able to get their hands on Grand Theft Auto 6 . While Rockstar’s gigantic open-world is sure to keep players occupied for a very long time, it’s certainly not the last video game that will ever be released. There are plenty of promising games on the horizon beyond GTA 6 .

item.title: All main story missions in GTA 6
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a big game, and that extends to its story. It features the longest campaign of any GTA game by a wide margin, taking well over 50 hours to complete even at a rushed rate. If you’re looking for an easy way to keep track of your progress as you play, we’ve got all the details you need.

item.title: GTA 6 Sets New Sales Record for Rockstar Just One Day In
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 was setting records before it was even released . Now that it's out, don't expect that pace to slow down anytime soon. New estimates suggest GTA 6 is not just the fastest-selling video game ever, but the fastest-selling piece of entertainment ever.
